text: {"overall_winner": "B", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Essay A cuts off abruptly mid-sentence (\"es\"), whereas Essay B provides a complete essay with a conclusion.", "quality": "structural completeness", "description": "Measures whether an essay presents a finished response rather than an incomplete fragment."}, {"evidence": "Essay B maintains a long, multi-point argument detailing jobs, advanced courses, sports, clubs, and tutoring.", "quality": "elaboration of ideas", "description": "Captures the depth and extent to which supporting reasons and details are developed."}, {"evidence": "Using transition words and phrases like \"Another reason why\", \"One other major reason\", and \"My conclusion is\".", "quality": "discourse organization", "description": "Reflects the logical structuring and signaling of main ideas and transitions across paragraphs."}, {"evidence": "Phrases like \"attending a community college\", \"work force\", and \"upcoming season\".", "quality": "vocabulary range", "description": "Demonstrates the variety and sophistication of topic-appropriate words and expressions used."}]}
